name: Beat clock
doc: A continuous beat counter locked to the beat phase: out = (beats x rate mod 1024) / 1024. Bind it with range [0, 1024] to a 'beats' param so grids, slats and terrain scroll exactly one step per beat. Also a per-beat kick envelope (1 on the beat, decaying).

out.doc: beats / 1024 (wraps every 1024 beats); bind with range [0, 1024]

kick.doc: 1 at each beat, decaying over the beat (shape by 'sharp')
